# Deluxe Nails - Round Rock

> Nail salon & nail art based in Round Rock, Texas. Acrylic and gel sets, Gel-X and dip, French tips with 3D flowers and rhinestones, ombre art and pedicures, in a gilded little salon on E Palm Valley Blvd. Walk-ins welcome, seven days a week.

- Phone: (512) 733-2300
- Based in: Round Rock, TX
- Nearby areas: Round Rock, Hutto, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Cedar Park, Austin
- Google rating: 3.9 from 264 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/deluxe-nails-round-rock/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/deluxe-nails-round-rock/book.html

## Services
- Acrylic & gel sets: Full sets and fills in any length and shape, from short almond to long coffin, finished glossy.
- French tips & 3D art: Crisp French tips dressed up with 3D roses, bows, pearls, rhinestones and fine line accents.
- Ombre & glitter: Hand-blended ombre fades, glitter fades and baby boomer nude-to-white, in any color off the wall.
- Gel-X & dip: Soft-gel Gel-X extensions and SNS dip powder. Tell your tech what you have on now, and they'll talk you through a fill or a fresh set.
- Pedicures: Pedicures in the massage chairs, finished with polish, gel or a little flower art on the big toe.
- Manicures & brows: Gel or regular polish manicures, quick polish changes, and eyebrow waxing to add on while you're in.

## About
Deluxe Nails sits in the strip center at 1700 E Palm Valley Blvd in Round Rock, behind the H-E-B gas station and next to Wingstop, with its own parking lot out front. Look for the purple deco sign. Step inside and it's a little bit of luxe: carved, gilded chairs at the manicure tables, an ornate gold mirror, stone-textured walls, massage pedicure chairs, big-screen TVs and a polish wall stocked with hundreds of colors. Clients know the techs by name. Regulars have been seeing Tera for years, one of them driving 35 minutes each visit. Tony is known for fixing lifted sets and shaping a perfect coffin, Howie for talking nail health, and Sara for her pedicure massage.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 9:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m., Saturday 9 a.m. to 7 p.m., and Sunday 11 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Holiday hours can differ, so call (512) 733-2300 if you're not sure.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. To skip the wait, call ahead or send a booking request online.
- Q: Where are you, and where do I park?
  A: 1700 E Palm Valley Blvd, Ste 460, Round Rock, TX 78664: the strip center behind the H-E-B gas station, next to Wingstop. There's a private parking lot right out front.
- Q: Do you do Gel-X and dip?
  A: Yes, along with acrylic and gel full sets and fills. Tell your tech what you have on now and what you want, and they'll walk you through a fill versus a new set, and the price, before starting.
- Q: Can I ask for a specific tech?
  A: Of course. Many clients book with the same tech every time. Call ahead and ask for them by name.
- Q: Can I bring a nail-art photo?
  A: Please do. French tips with 3D flowers, bows, rhinestones, ombre, glitter fades, foil and line art are all things our techs do every day.
